summary: Master advanced financial modelling, DCF valuation, and M&A analysis. Build investment-grade models and drive strategic decisions. Enroll today.
lede: Financial modelling and valuation use linked financial assumptions to forecast company performance and assess its value. For finance professionals ready to move beyond basic spreadsheet work, the course covers building integrated three-statement models, applying DCF and market-multiple valuation, and testing transaction outcomes with LBO and sensitivity analysis.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for finance professionals who have mastered basic spreadsheet functions and now require the technical depth to lead complex valuation and transaction analysis.
prerequisites: Participants must have a strong working knowledge of Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, basic IF statements) and a solid understanding of financial accounting principles (Balance Sheets, P&L, Cash Flow). No prior coding experience is required, though familiarity with financial statements is essential for the advanced modules.
